requirements_summary: Primary workloads: live product-ranking reranking (low latency), customer chat assistant (rich context), nightly embeddings ETL
Latency targets: reranking p95 <= 120ms; chat p95 <= 450ms for first token + streaming acceptable; embeddings 99th <= 1s
Throughput targets: steady-state QPS across platform ~40 QPS aggregate; holiday peak QPS up to 240 for rerank subpath
Cost profile: prioritize predictable committed cost; willing to pay premium for reserved guarantees and hot-standby for black-swan events
Security: VPC-only control plane option, SSO (SAML), key rotation via customer KMS, audit logs retained 7 years per retail compliance
workshop_findings: Workshop run 2026-02-18: team provided 7 days of telemetry (QPS per route, tokens per request distribution)
Observed baseline (median week): aggregate steady QPS = 42 (rerank 18, chat 15, embeddings 9)
Seen peak bursts tied to marketing pushes: 10x baseline short bursts (30-90s windows)
Token distributions: rerank median payload 48 tokens, chat response median 140 tokens, embeddings 256 tokens
Prefix reuse high on personalization calls -> good candidate for KV/prefix caching to reduce effective compute by ~22%
sizing_estimates: Assumptions used: H100-class performance estimates: 13B-class model ~700 tok/s per GPU, 6.7B rerank model ~1500 tok/s per GPU, embeddings batch throughput ~5000 tok/s per GPU (batched)
Rerank steady: 18 QPS * 48 tokens = 864 tok/s -> ~1 H100 (1500 tok/s capacity) comfortably handles steady; peak burst 180 QPS equivalent (10x) -> 180*48=8640 tok/s -> ~6 H100 for peak bursts
Chat steady: 15 QPS * 140 tokens = 2100 tok/s -> ~3 H100 required for steady chat; peak chat 40 QPS -> 40*140=5600 tok/s -> ~8 H100 for peak
Embeddings (nightly & online): steady 9 QPS * 256 tokens = 2304 tok/s but highly batchable; propose 2x A10/A100-class GPU nodes for daytime embedding traffic and separate batch runners at night

Cross-workload pooling: with mixed-model routing + autoscaler, recommended reserved pool = 10 x H100 (dedicated) sized to cover combined steady-state with 20% headroom and handle typical bursts via burst pool to 14 H100; separate 2 x A100 for embeddings batch processing
Suggested safety buffer: +20% for model changes and cache warming, recommend canary 2-week POC before final commit
proposed_sla_and_terms: Target uptime: 99.95% monthly for Dedicated pool; credit tiers discussed (pro-rated for minute-level outages)
Latency SLOs to be contractualized per route: rerank p95 <= 120ms; chat first-token p95 <= 450ms (with streaming fallback for tail cases)
Capacity guarantee: Redwood to reserve 10 H100-equivalent GPUs with autoscale burst agreement to 14 H100 for seasonal peaks (billing/tier terms to be negotiated)
Operational windows & maintenance: rolling upgrades with 1% performance degradation cap during maintenance; defined notification windows
Security & compliance: SOC2 evidence, SAML SSO config runbook, KMS key access attestation; Redwood to provide audit log exporter (S3 delivery)
